cases.baseline_requirement: District meters shall record flow every fifteen minutes.
cases.message: Could we take a reading every ten minutes instead?
cases.proposed_rationale: The same flow measurement remains, with a shorter sampling interval.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patrons may borrow ordinary books for fourteen days.
cases.message: Set the ordinary-book loan period to twenty-one days for everyone.
cases.proposed_rationale: The loan capability persists with a changed duration.

cases.baseline_requirement: The cargo desk shall acknowledge a temperature alarm within thirty minutes of receipt.
cases.message: Make that response window twenty minutes; the desk still owns the acknowledgement.
cases.proposed_rationale: Only the acknowledgement deadline changes.

cases.baseline_requirement: School office staff shall correct a student's attendance record after a documented appeal.
cases.message: After an appeal, let the class teacher make that correction instead of the office team.
cases.proposed_rationale: The correction workflow remains but the authorized actor changes.
cases.notes: Reviewer should check whether actor replacement counts as removed under P1.

cases.baseline_requirement: The public flood dashboard shall display river depth in metres to one decimal place.
cases.message: Display that depth in centimetres, retaining the same one-decimal precision.
cases.proposed_rationale: The same measurement remains with a changed unit.

cases.baseline_requirement: A driver may extend a parking session during the five-minute grace period after expiry.
cases.message: The grace period should last twelve minutes after expiry.
cases.proposed_rationale: Extension remains available with a different cutoff.

cases.baseline_requirement: Unanswered high-priority triage calls shall escalate to the on-call nurse after eight minutes.
cases.message: Please make the escalation happen after five minutes, without changing who receives it.
cases.proposed_rationale: The escalation route remains and only the delay changes.

cases.baseline_requirement: The irrigation planner shall recalculate the field schedule each Monday morning.
cases.message: Could it recalculate at the start of every day instead?
cases.proposed_rationale: Recalculation remains, with higher frequency.

cases.baseline_requirement: The collections team shall receive a weekly PDF summary of gallery humidity readings.
cases.message: Keep the weekly summary, but send it as an HTML page rather than a PDF.
cases.proposed_rationale: The report survives with a different presentation format.
cases.notes: Reviewer should decide whether explicit PDF elimination is removed under P1.

cases.baseline_requirement: Quality staff shall inspect one valve from each lot of twenty manufactured valves.
cases.message: Inspect one valve per ten in the lot from now on.
cases.proposed_rationale: The sampling workflow remains with a denser rate.

cases.baseline_requirement: Volunteers may claim up to forty dollars for approved local travel per event.
cases.message: Raise the local-travel reimbursement ceiling to sixty dollars per event.
cases.proposed_rationale: The reimbursement remains with an increased cap.

cases.baseline_requirement: Specimen labels shall show the eight-character accession code beside the sample date.
cases.message: The accession code is moving to twelve characters; keep the date beside it.
cases.proposed_rationale: Label content remains but a field constraint changes.

cases.baseline_requirement: A zoning clerk shall review each permit application before the building unit receives it.
cases.message: Route that first review to the planning officer, then continue sending the file to the building unit.
cases.proposed_rationale: The review sequence persists with a changed reviewer role.

cases.baseline_requirement: The battery operator shall publish a monthly utilisation summary on the first business day of the next month.
cases.message: Publish the same utilisation summary quarterly, on the first business day after each quarter closes.
cases.proposed_rationale: The report persists while cadence and deadline change.

cases.baseline_requirement: Digitised film previews shall be available at 1080p resolution.
cases.message: Make the preview stream 4K while leaving the archive download unchanged.
cases.proposed_rationale: The preview capability continues with higher resolution.

cases.baseline_requirement: Passengers shall receive a printable boarding pass by email after booking.
cases.message: Let passengers also show a boarding pass inside the mobile app; keep the emailed copy.
cases.proposed_rationale: An additional boarding channel is introduced while email remains.

cases.baseline_requirement: The clinic shall email owners when a pet's laboratory result is ready.
cases.message: Can owners opt into a text alert as well as the existing email?
cases.proposed_rationale: SMS is an additional notification option.

cases.baseline_requirement: Ground staff shall view a flight's assigned gate on the operations board.
cases.message: Show an estimated boarding-start time next to the gate on that board.
cases.proposed_rationale: A new data item is requested without replacing the gate.

cases.baseline_requirement: Ticket buyers shall select an available numbered seat.
cases.message: Keep seat selection and add an optional field for access needs at checkout.
cases.proposed_rationale: An optional checkout field is added to an intact seat-selection flow.

cases.baseline_requirement: The warning service shall sound a riverside siren when the flood threshold is crossed.
cases.message: The siren still sounds; send an app push alert at the same threshold too.
cases.proposed_rationale: Push delivery is a new parallel alert channel.

cases.baseline_requirement: Field sensors shall upload soil moisture readings each hour.
cases.message: Alongside moisture, could those uploads include soil pH?
cases.proposed_rationale: Soil pH is a new measured data item.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patrons shall search the catalogue by book title.
cases.message: Please add author-name search without removing title search.
cases.proposed_rationale: A second search key is offered while the first remains.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall view their appointment letters in the patient portal.
cases.message: Allow a patient to nominate a caregiver who may also view those letters.
cases.proposed_rationale: A delegated actor is added to existing patient access.

cases.baseline_requirement: Managers shall download a monthly PDF of completed repair counts.
cases.message: Could we offer a CSV download of the same counts beside the PDF?
cases.proposed_rationale: CSV is a new export option; PDF remains.

cases.baseline_requirement: Pickers shall confirm each picked item by scanning its barcode.
cases.message: Keep barcode confirmation, but let a picker attach an optional spoken note when a shelf is damaged.
cases.proposed_rationale: An optional voice-note capability is added.

cases.baseline_requirement: Inspectors shall attach a photograph to each track defect report.
cases.message: Let inspectors attach a short video clip too, while continuing to require the photograph.
cases.proposed_rationale: Video is a new attachment type alongside the required photo.

cases.baseline_requirement: Applicants shall lodge permit applications through the city website.
cases.message: Keep the website, and let the service desk record applications made by phone.
cases.proposed_rationale: Telephone intake is an additional application channel.

cases.baseline_requirement: Analysts shall annotate images by drawing polygons around observed land changes.
cases.message: Can analysts also mark uncertain areas with freehand strokes? Polygon annotation stays available.
cases.proposed_rationale: Freehand annotation is an additional tool.

cases.baseline_requirement: A donor shall receive a PDF receipt for each contribution.
cases.message: Add a yearly gift total to the donor dashboard; individual PDF receipts should continue.
cases.proposed_rationale: An aggregate dashboard data item is introduced.

cases.baseline_requirement: Claimants may upload photographs of damaged property with a claim.
cases.message: Give claimants an optional voice-note attachment as well as photos.
cases.proposed_rationale: A new attachment modality is added.

cases.baseline_requirement: Inspectors shall attach photographs and notes to every failed vehicle inspection.
cases.message: Stop collecting the photographs; retain the written notes.
cases.proposed_rationale: An explicitly supported evidence item is eliminated.

cases.baseline_requirement: Guests may request room service through both the mobile app and the front desk.
cases.message: Retire in-app room-service requests; the desk can still take them.
cases.proposed_rationale: One supported request channel is removed.

cases.baseline_requirement: Visitors shall search the public docket by case number or party name.
cases.message: Take away party-name lookup, but leave case-number search.
cases.proposed_rationale: One search option is withdrawn.

cases.baseline_requirement: Applicants shall receive both email and SMS when an award decision is issued.
cases.message: We no longer want the text message; send only the email.
cases.proposed_rationale: SMS notification is removed.

cases.baseline_requirement: Ticket holders may present either a QR code or a printable ticket at entry.
cases.message: Retire printable admission tickets; QR entry stays.
cases.proposed_rationale: The printable option is withdrawn.

cases.baseline_requirement: Students shall open course notes in the browser or download them as PDF.
cases.message: Disable PDF downloads of notes while keeping browser access.
cases.proposed_rationale: The download option is removed.

cases.baseline_requirement: The public forecast shall display wind speed and relative humidity.
cases.message: Hide relative humidity from the public forecast, but retain wind speed.
cases.proposed_rationale: A displayed data item is removed.

cases.baseline_requirement: Donors may choose a one-time or monthly contribution.
cases.message: The donation form should offer monthly contributions only.
cases.proposed_rationale: One contribution option is withdrawn.

cases.baseline_requirement: Pilots may approve a berth plan from the web console or mobile app.
cases.message: Remove berth-plan approval from phones; leave the web console alone.
cases.proposed_rationale: Mobile approval is eliminated.

cases.baseline_requirement: Staff may export specimen results as PDF or CSV.
cases.message: We can do without the CSV export; preserve the PDF.
cases.proposed_rationale: One export format is removed.

cases.baseline_requirement: Workers shall sign into the assembly terminal using either a badge or PIN.
cases.message: Drop PIN sign-in; badges will still work.
cases.proposed_rationale: One authentication option is withdrawn.

cases.baseline_requirement: Dispensing alerts shall appear on the dashboard and be emailed to the pharmacist.
cases.message: Stop the email copy of dispensing alerts; the dashboard alert remains.
cases.proposed_rationale: An alert channel is removed.

cases.baseline_requirement: Students may enroll through the online portal or a campus kiosk.
cases.message: Close kiosk enrollment after term ends; online enrollment remains.
cases.proposed_rationale: A supported enrollment channel is withdrawn.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patrons may renew eligible loans online or at the circulation desk.
cases.message: Please end in-person renewal but keep online renewal.
cases.proposed_rationale: A renewal channel is removed.

cases.baseline_requirement: Customers may pay bills by card or bank transfer.
cases.message: Remove card payments from the bill screen; bank transfer continues.
cases.proposed_rationale: One payment option is removed.

cases.baseline_requirement: The crossing barrier must remain closed until the last train carriage clears the crossing.
cases.message: Raise the barrier while the train is still passing so traffic can move.
cases.proposed_rationale: The request directly violates the required closed-until-clear invariant.

cases.baseline_requirement: The public appointment display must never show a patient's full national identifier.
cases.message: Put each patient's full national identifier on the public display.
cases.proposed_rationale: The request directly violates a never-display constraint.

cases.baseline_requirement: Only a certified flight dispatcher may approve a flight release.
cases.message: Let an uncertified trainee approve a release alone.
cases.proposed_rationale: The proposed actor is expressly excluded by the only rule.

cases.baseline_requirement: Vaccines must remain below five degrees Celsius throughout transit.
cases.message: Allow vaccine boxes to travel at ten degrees Celsius for the full route.
cases.proposed_rationale: The requested temperature is incompatible with a strict upper bound.

cases.baseline_requirement: The ballot-counting terminal must never connect to an external network.
cases.message: Sync ballot totals directly from that terminal to a cloud service.
cases.proposed_rationale: Cloud syncing contradicts the network isolation rule.

cases.baseline_requirement: A maintenance crew may enter the pump chamber only after electrical isolation is confirmed.
cases.message: Send the crew into the chamber before isolation is confirmed.
cases.proposed_rationale: The requested sequence breaches an only-after condition.

cases.baseline_requirement: Ultraviolet lamps must never be used in the manuscript display case.
cases.message: Install a UV lamp inside that display case for the exhibition.
cases.proposed_rationale: The prohibited device is expressly requested.

cases.baseline_requirement: Student grades must not be visible to students before the official release time.
cases.message: Give students a preview of their own grades an hour before release.
cases.proposed_rationale: Early visibility is forbidden by the baseline.

cases.baseline_requirement: Every high-value transfer must be approved by two distinct authorizers before execution.
cases.message: Execute a high-value transfer after just one person approves it.
cases.proposed_rationale: One approval violates the explicit two-person minimum.

cases.baseline_requirement: Hazardous-goods deliveries must never be routed through residential streets.
cases.message: Route a hazardous-goods delivery through the nearby housing estate.
cases.proposed_rationale: The proposed route uses a prohibited street type.

cases.baseline_requirement: A blood specimen may be collected only after informed consent is recorded.
cases.message: Collect the specimen first and record consent afterward.
cases.proposed_rationale: Collection precedes the required consent record.

cases.baseline_requirement: Every visitor must be escorted while inside the restricted laboratory.
cases.message: Let a visitor tour the restricted laboratory unaccompanied.
cases.proposed_rationale: Unescorted access conflicts with the every-visitor escort rule.

cases.baseline_requirement: The exact coordinates of protected nesting sites must never be shown publicly.
cases.message: Publish a public map with each protected nest's exact coordinates.
cases.proposed_rationale: The requested disclosure is explicitly barred.

cases.baseline_requirement: The turbine must be shut down before anyone enters its service enclosure.
cases.message: Keep the turbine running while a technician enters the enclosure.
cases.proposed_rationale: Entry with the turbine running breaches the before-entry rule.

cases.baseline_requirement: Dispensing staff must verify the patient's identifier before handing over any prescription.
cases.message: For repeat prescriptions, hand over the medicine without checking the identifier.
cases.proposed_rationale: The exception contradicts the universal verification requirement.

cases.baseline_requirement: Dispatchers shall assign an ambulance within six minutes of a priority-one call.
cases.message: Can we make the handoff feel faster somehow?
cases.proposed_rationale: No measurable change or specific workflow is identified.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patrons may borrow ordinary books for fourteen days.
cases.message: Perhaps ordinary loans should be a bit more generous. We have not settled on a duration.
cases.proposed_rationale: A direction is suggested but the intended constraint is unresolved.

cases.baseline_requirement: Applicants shall upload a site plan and an ownership document with each permit request.
cases.message: Maybe tighten the attachment rules next year; we have not chosen which files.
cases.proposed_rationale: Neither the attachments nor rule change is specified.

cases.baseline_requirement: The museum shall open at nine each morning and close at five each evening.
cases.message: The opening hours are not working well; let's discuss a better schedule.
cases.proposed_rationale: A dissatisfaction statement does not settle a new schedule.

cases.baseline_requirement: The irrigation scheduler shall publish a daily watering plan for each field.
cases.message: Should we automate more of the field work one day? This is only an idea.
cases.proposed_rationale: The hypothetical does not define a specific change to the daily plan.

cases.baseline_requirement: The system shall email a pharmacist each time a stock item reaches its reorder point.
cases.message: Alerts should be more helpful, without getting annoying.
cases.proposed_rationale: Neither the alert behavior nor threshold is determinable.

cases.baseline_requirement: Students shall see final grades only after the registrar publishes them.
cases.message: We need to revisit when students can see marks, but faculty disagree about timing.
cases.proposed_rationale: There is no chosen replacement rule.

cases.baseline_requirement: A vehicle shall be flagged when its payload exceeds twelve tonnes.
cases.message: Could we use the threshold we had last year? I cannot remember what it was.
cases.proposed_rationale: The requested threshold is unknown.

cases.baseline_requirement: Attendees may request a refund until forty-eight hours before a performance.
cases.message: Some staff want a longer cancellation window and others want a shorter one; no decision yet.
cases.proposed_rationale: Conflicting proposals do not identify a decided change.

cases.baseline_requirement: The ward shall send discharge summaries to the attending physician at the end of each day.
cases.message: Nurses say send these earlier; doctors say later. We have not agreed.
cases.proposed_rationale: The new delivery time is unresolved.

cases.baseline_requirement: The control room shall report the battery's peak output each day.
cases.message: Could we make the peak figures better for the board?
cases.proposed_rationale: Better is underspecified; no distinct data or format change is settled.

cases.baseline_requirement: Residents shall receive a text alert when the coastal flood level reaches the red band.
cases.message: Maybe drop texts and use the app instead, or maybe keep both; we're still debating.
cases.proposed_rationale: Mutually different changes are proposed without a decision.

cases.baseline_requirement: Reviewers shall score each application against four published criteria.
cases.message: We should make the scoring fairer, but the revised formula is still being worked out.
cases.proposed_rationale: No concrete scoring rule can be inferred.

cases.baseline_requirement: Pickers shall scan a shelf label before removing each item.
cases.message: Do we still need all these scans, or is there a less manual approach?
cases.proposed_rationale: The question offers no committed alternative workflow.

cases.baseline_requirement: Claimants may attach a photograph when submitting a new claim.
cases.message: Let them do it again like before; I mean the other thing.
cases.proposed_rationale: The referent and intended action cannot be resolved from the pair.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patrons may borrow ordinary books for twenty-one days.
cases.message: So ordinary books can be kept for three weeks, right?
cases.proposed_rationale: Three weeks is semantically equivalent to twenty-one days.

cases.baseline_requirement: The system shall email a boarding pass to each passenger after booking.
cases.message: After someone books, send their boarding pass to their email address.
cases.proposed_rationale: The same delivery action and timing are restated.

cases.baseline_requirement: Each custody transfer record shall contain the receiving staff member's name and transfer time.
cases.message: Record who received the specimen and when the handoff happened.
cases.proposed_rationale: The same two custody data fields are requested.

cases.baseline_requirement: Visitors shall search issued permits by street address.
cases.message: Please add a fee estimator for permit applicants.
cases.proposed_rationale: A fee estimator is same-domain but does not change address lookup.

cases.baseline_requirement: Baggage handlers shall see the last scan location of each checked bag.
cases.message: Give passengers a seat-map preview before check-in.
cases.proposed_rationale: Seat-map preview does not change baggage scan location access.

cases.baseline_requirement: Operators shall be able to stop an irrigation pump remotely.
cases.message: Let an operator switch off the irrigation pump from elsewhere.
cases.proposed_rationale: Remote pump stopping is restated in different words.

cases.baseline_requirement: Managers shall download a monthly summary of discharge counts.
cases.message: Let patients preselect a meal from the ward menu.
cases.proposed_rationale: Meal selection is unrelated to the discharge-count report.

cases.baseline_requirement: Door staff shall scan a visitor's QR ticket to admit them.
cases.message: Add Spanish narration to the audio guide.
cases.proposed_rationale: Audio-guide language does not alter QR admission.

cases.baseline_requirement: Operators shall receive an alert after battery temperature exceeds forty degrees for ten minutes.
cases.message: Notify the operator when the battery stays above forty degrees for a full ten minutes.
cases.proposed_rationale: The same threshold and duration are restated.

cases.baseline_requirement: The inventory screen shall show each bin's SKU identifier.
cases.message: Display the SKU code beside each storage bin.
cases.proposed_rationale: The same identifier visibility is restated.

cases.baseline_requirement: The public map shall display the next bus arrival time for each stop.
cases.message: Change the wording on emailed fare receipts.
cases.proposed_rationale: Receipt wording does not modify arrival times on the map.

cases.baseline_requirement: The system shall email a receipt after each completed donation.
cases.message: Once a contribution goes through, send its receipt to the donor by email.
cases.proposed_rationale: The same receipt action is paraphrased.

cases.baseline_requirement: Students shall book available study rooms through the campus portal.
cases.message: Show lecture timetable colours in the student portal.
cases.proposed_rationale: Timetable presentation does not alter study-room booking.

cases.baseline_requirement: Claimants shall download a PDF copy of their submitted claim.
cases.message: Add a camera shortcut for taking claim photos.
cases.proposed_rationale: The shortcut does not alter PDF claim download.

cases.baseline_requirement: The station shall sample wind speed every five minutes.
cases.message: Take a wind-speed reading once every five minutes.
cases.proposed_rationale: The same sampling cadence is restated.
